mainEntity.name: What is Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) for financial advisors?

acceptedAnswer.text: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) uses AI to enhance a financial advisor's online visibility and reputation. It involves leveraging generative AI models to create and optimize content, respond to inquiries, and manage online presence. This approach aims to position advisors effectively across search engines and AI-driven platforms, helping them connect with prospective clients searching for financial advice. GEO focuses on both traditional search visibility and emerging generative search experiences.
acceptedAnswer.description: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) uses AI to improve a financial advisor's online visibility and reputation by creating and optimizing content for search engines and AI platforms.
